Name: Forager's Nooks and Crannies Compatibility Hub
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854442-1419077452.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[b][color=#ff0000]Please note there were major changes between v1.3.0 and v2.0.0. Read the Requirements and Installation sections carefully.[/color][/b]

A pair of compatibility patches for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies[/url], one for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]'s Secret Woods map, and one for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095]Gem Sea Shores[/url]' Beach map. You can run this mod with either or both of SVE and GSS. Technically you can run it with neither, but that would be silly.

For the SVE patch, the entrance to the Mushroom Forest is moved 20 tiles to the right.

For the GSS patch, the hidden entrance to the Mermaid Lagoon is restored.

This mod was created and released with Wildflourmods' permission, however, and [b]I cannot stress this enough[/b], do [b][u]not[/u][/b] bug Wildflourmods if you run into issues with it. You shouldn't run into any issues, but if you do, ask in the comments here or raise a bug report.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854450-789182973.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+﻿[/*]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (Optional, for the SVE Patch) [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095]Gem Sea Shores[/url] (Optional, for the GSS Patch)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] (Optional, recommended if installing mid-game)﻿[/*]
[/list]
[center][u][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854457-128975496.png[/img][/u][/center]

If you have v1.3.0 of [b]Forager's Nooks and Crannies and Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility Patch[/b] installed, remove it, and if you're not using a mod manager, that is, you have replaced files belonging to Forager's Nooks and Crannies, reinstall it FNaC fresh before proceeding.

[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Forager's Nooks and Crannies Compatibility Hub[/b] to your mods folder.[/*]
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file and install as usual.[/*]
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do![/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854464-2131402090.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
Version 2.0.0 of this mod is compatible with Forager's Nooks and Crannies v2.2.1, Stardew Valley Expanded v1.15.11, and Gem Sea Shores v1.1.2.
